> **Looking for Magika's supported output content types?** This document covers only the **`standard_v3_3` deep learning model** itself. Magika (the CLI and language bindings) combines built-in heuristics, native format resolvers, and the deep learning model, so the full output space (`output.label`) depends on the artifact and version. See [Supported Content Types by Version](/magika/content-types) (or the [`main` branch coverage reference](/magika/content-types/main)).

## Model Overview & Configuration

- **Trained target classes (`target_labels_space`)**: 214 labels (212 effective model-predicted content types after `overwrite_map`).
- **Input feature window**: first `1024` bytes (`beg_size`) and last `1024` bytes (`end_size`) read within `4096`-byte blocks (`block_size`), padded with token `256` (`padding_token`); minimum file size for model inference is `8` bytes (`min_file_size_for_dl`).
- **Confidence thresholds**: default `medium_confidence_threshold` = `0.5`, with per-label high-confidence overrides on 12 label(s) (see `Notes` below).
- **Canonical label remapping (`overwrite_map`)**: `randombytes` -> `unknown`, `randomtxt` -> `txt` (raw calibration classes that may appear in `dl.label` before being remapped when producing `output.label`).
- **Skipped-inference sentinel (`undefined`)**: not a neural-network output class, but reported in `dl.label` whenever the model was not evaluated (for example on directories, symlinks, empty or tiny files, or inputs resolved ahead of model inference).
